tools.name: translate_bets
tools.description: Send a list of picks (team, spread, total, player prop). Returns one squadride.app slip URL to share with the user plus per-sportsbook deep links that open the picks loaded. A total needs "event". Team codes ("KC") and nicknames ("Chiefs") work.

tools.name: get_slip
tools.description: Fetch a slip by id (the part after /slip/ in a squadride.app link) and list its picks.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: Sportsbooks SquadRide can open, with health from the daily port check.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: translate_bets · Public sink: translate_bets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: translate_bets · Public sink: translate_bets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
